title: Operational learning promotion loop for startup orientation
description: Implement IDEA-0022/PROMO-0011: convert incident-derived operational notes into selectively promoted, canonical, scope-matched startup guidance. Reuse E/I as the capture and promotion funnel; do not create a second task authority or load raw emergence history into every session. Active lessons need provenance, scope, status, expiry/review trigger, and supersession. Startup orientation must surface relevant active lessons automatically, with validation/tests proving retrieval and retirement.
acceptance_criteria: Defines the lifecycle from raw note/Insight through reviewed promotion to active startup guidance, including expiry, supersession, and ownership.
Provides one canonical machine-readable active-lesson source or generated view rather than duplicating AGENTS, current-state, and task authority.
Startup orientation or its existing runner surfaces active scope-matched lessons without requiring agents to search arbitrary notes.
Includes a deterministic test using the Claude-to-Codex fallback, plus stale/conflict validation and retirement behavior.
Documents migration/usage and passes focused tests, emergence validation, task graph validation, and task mirror validation.
